status: chip numbers derived from sky130-reram-fpga via chip_profile.json (input digest 626e26b0d8bfea9f); weights.magnitude_bits and weights.sign_factor follow BMsemi_Model DeepGate and are not stated by the chip repo

basis.cell_bits: 4: DECISION (user, 2026-11-13) to follow BMsemi DeepGate 4-bit banks (BMsemi_Model/projects/1_foundation/PE/variants/deep_gate/Crossbar_array.py l.127, 165). NOT what the chip repo models: its behavioral X2 computes with 1-bit cells (ip/sky130_bmlabs_reram/verilog/behavioral/sky130_bmlabs_reram__cim32x32.sv l.802, l.847-848), so 4-bit plans cannot be checked in that simulation. Pending team confirmation of the silicon cell precision.
basis.timing_cycles: READ/PROGRAM/COMPUTE_DELAY parameters (ip/sky130_bmlabs_reram/verilog/behavioral/sky130_bmlabs_reram__cim32x32.sv l.14-16): behavioral model, not silicon

weights.basis: BMsemi_Model/projects/1_foundation/PE/variants/deep_gate/Crossbar_array.py l.29-30: signed INT8 weights split into positive/negative banks (w = w_pos - w_neg); l.127/165 store each magnitude as two 4-bit banks, i.e. 8 magnitude bits. With x2.cell_bits = 4: 2 x ceil(8 / 4) = 4 cells per weight.
weights.open_question: silicon cell precision: deep_gate/Crossbar_array.py uses 4-bit banks (4 cells per weight); the X2 behavioral model computes with 1-bit cells (16 cells per weight).

efpga.basis: BEL counts in .FABulous/bel.txt (one LUT4 + FF per FABULOUS_LC); io_pins = IOBUF sites, the team confirmed all[0..27] in constraints.pcf are example assignments only. Per-operator resource estimates still need RTL (run_chip_flow.py).

activation_bytes_basis: X2 inputs are 8-bit (ip/sky130_bmlabs_reram/verilog/behavioral/sky130_bmlabs_reram__cim32x32.sv l.38); DeepGate activations are unsigned INT8 (Crossbar_array.py l.28). compiler_graph.json itself records no dtype.

compiler_v2.basis: BMsemi_Model bm_models/core/mapping.py PEGeometry default (64 x 32, the 'YOLO26 / FP4LLM' geometry, mapping.py l.4-6/20-21). Used ONLY to check the compiler's own tile counts (compiler_expected_tiles); the chip is 32 x 32.
